# 28\. FSFO (Fast Start Failover) Overview

Fast Start Failover enables automatic failover to a pre-designated target standby without any DBA intervention. An Observer process continuously monitors both the primary and standby, and initiates failover if the primary is unreachable for longer than the configured threshold.

## 28.1 FSFO Architecture

┌───────────────────────┐ heartbeat ┌────────────────────────┐

│ PRIMARY (CDBPRIM) │◄────────────────►│ OBSERVER │

│ lnx107 │ │ (lnx113 or 3rd host) │

└──────────┬────────────┘ └────────────┬───────────┘

│ │

│ redo transport │ heartbeat

▼ ▼

┌───────────────────────┐◄──────────────────────────────┘

│ STANDBY (CDBSTBY) │

│ lnx113 │

└───────────────────────┘

If Observer cannot reach PRIMARY and STANDBY is healthy:

→ Observer instructs STANDBY to failover automatically

→ CDBSTBY becomes PRIMARY without any DBA action

## 28.2 FSFO Requirements

| **Requirement**         | **Detail**                                                       |
| ----------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Data Guard Broker       | Must be configured, enabled, and stable                          |
| Protection Mode         | Max Availability or Max Protection (not Max Performance)         |
| Observer                | Separate process; ideally on a 3rd host not primary or standby   |
| Flashback Database      | Required on both primary and standby for automatic reinstatement |
| FastStartFailoverTarget | Must be set on both members pointing to each other               |
| Network                 | Observer must independently reach both primary and standby       |

## 28.3 FSFO Key Properties

| **Property**                   | **Default** | **Recommended Lab Value** | **Description**                                         |
| ------------------------------ | ----------- | ------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| FastStartFailoverThreshold     | 30          | 30                        | Seconds before FSFO triggers after primary loss         |
| FastStartFailoverLagLimit      | 30          | 30                        | Max apply lag (seconds) for FSFO to be armed            |
| FastStartFailoverAutoReinstate | TRUE        | TRUE                      | Auto-reinstate old primary as standby after FSFO        |
| FastStartFailoverPmyShutdown   | TRUE        | TRUE                      | Shut down old primary after FSFO to prevent split-brain |
| ObserverOverride               | FALSE       | FALSE                     | Allows manual override of Observer decision             |

## 29.2 Configure FSFO Properties

\-- Set FSFO target on each member (each points to the other)

EDIT DATABASE 'CDBPRIM' SET PROPERTY FastStartFailoverTarget='CDBSTBY';

EDIT DATABASE 'CDBSTBY' SET PROPERTY FastStartFailoverTarget='CDBPRIM';

\-- Set failover threshold (30 seconds - how long before FSFO triggers)

EDIT CONFIGURATION SET PROPERTY FastStartFailoverThreshold=30;

\-- Set lag limit (standby must be within 30 seconds of primary)

EDIT CONFIGURATION SET PROPERTY FastStartFailoverLagLimit=30;

\-- Enable auto reinstatement of old primary after FSFO

EDIT CONFIGURATION SET PROPERTY FastStartFailoverAutoReinstate=TRUE;

\-- Shut down old primary after FSFO to prevent split-brain

EDIT CONFIGURATION SET PROPERTY FastStartFailoverPmyShutdown=TRUE;

\-- Verify properties set

SHOW DATABASE VERBOSE 'CDBPRIM';

## 29.4 Start Observer (on lnx113 as oracle - separate terminal)

The observer file does not exist yet - it gets **created automatically** when the Observer starts for the first time. You do not need to create it manually.

The FILE= parameter tells dgmgrl where to **create and store** the observer configuration file. It records:

- Which configuration the observer is monitoring
- Connection credentials
- Observer state and history

It is created the first time START OBSERVER runs successfully.

\# As oracle on lnx113 - open a NEW dedicated terminal for Observer

\# Observer must run continuously - use nohup to keep it running

nohup dgmgrl sys/ishan123@CDBPRIM_DIRECT \\

"START OBSERVER FILE='/u01/app/oracle/fsfo_observer.dat'" \\

\> /u01/app/oracle/observer.log 2>&1 &

echo \$! > /u01/app/oracle/observer.pid

echo "Observer PID: \$(cat /u01/app/oracle/observer.pid)"

\# Monitor observer startup

sleep 5

tail -20 /u01/app/oracle/observer.log

\[oracle@lnx113 ~\]\$ nohup dgmgrl sys/ishan123@CDBPRIM_DIRECT \\

\> "START OBSERVER FILE='/u01/app/oracle/fsfo_observer.dat'" \\

\> > /u01/app/oracle/observer.log 2>&1 &

# Appendix A - Quick Reference Command Table

All commands verified against actual lnx107/lnx113 lab environment. Commands marked \[grid\] run as grid OS user; \[oracle\] as oracle OS user; \[root\] as root.

## A.1 Data Guard - Primary Database Commands

| **Task**                    | **Command**                                                                                                         | **User** | **Node** |
| --------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | -------- |
| Check DB role and open mode | SELECT DB_UNIQUE_NAME, DATABASE_ROLE, OPEN_MODE, FLASHBACK_ON FROM V\$DATABASE;                                     | oracle   | lnx107   |
| Check protection mode       | SELECT PROTECTION_MODE, PROTECTION_LEVEL FROM V\$DATABASE;                                                          | oracle   | lnx107   |
| Enable Flashback Database   | ALTER DATABASE FLASHBACK ON;                                                                                        | oracle   | lnx107   |
| Enable FORCE LOGGING        | ALTER DATABASE FORCE LOGGING;                                                                                       | oracle   | lnx107   |
| Enable ARCHIVELOG           | SHUTDOWN IMMEDIATE; STARTUP MOUNT; ALTER DATABASE ARCHIVELOG; ALTER DATABASE OPEN;                                  | oracle   | lnx107   |
| Add Standby Redo Log        | ALTER DATABASE ADD STANDBY LOGFILE GROUP 4 ('+DATA') SIZE 200M;                                                     | oracle   | lnx107   |
| Check Standby Redo Logs     | SELECT GROUP#, BYTES/1024/1024 SIZE_MB, STATUS FROM V\$STANDBY_LOG ORDER BY GROUP#;                                 | oracle   | lnx107   |
| Check Online Redo Logs      | SELECT GROUP#, MEMBERS, BYTES/1024/1024 SIZE_MB, STATUS FROM V\$LOG ORDER BY GROUP#;                                | oracle   | lnx107   |
| Switch logfile              | ALTER SYSTEM SWITCH LOGFILE;                                                                                        | oracle   | lnx107   |
| Archive current log         | ALTER SYSTEM ARCHIVE LOG CURRENT;                                                                                   | oracle   | lnx107   |
| Check transport status      | SELECT DEST_ID, STATUS, ERROR, DB_UNIQUE_NAME FROM V\$ARCHIVE_DEST WHERE DEST_ID<=2;                                | oracle   | lnx107   |
| Check DEST_2 detail         | SELECT DEST_ID, STATUS, GAP_STATUS, SYNCHRONIZED, RECOVERY_MODE FROM V\$ARCHIVE_DEST_STATUS WHERE DEST_ID=2;        | oracle   | lnx107   |
| Defer redo transport        | ALTER SYSTEM SET LOG_ARCHIVE_DEST_STATE_2=DEFER SCOPE=BOTH;                                                         | oracle   | lnx107   |
| Enable redo transport       | ALTER SYSTEM SET LOG_ARCHIVE_DEST_STATE_2=ENABLE SCOPE=BOTH;                                                        | oracle   | lnx107   |
| Manual switchover step 1    | ALTER DATABASE COMMIT TO SWITCHOVER TO PHYSICAL STANDBY WITH SESSION SHUTDOWN;                                      | oracle   | lnx107   |
| Open PDBs                   | ALTER PLUGGABLE DATABASE ALL OPEN;                                                                                  | oracle   | lnx107   |
| Save PDB state              | ALTER PLUGGABLE DATABASE ALL SAVE STATE;                                                                            | oracle   | lnx107   |
| Set LOCAL_LISTENER          | ALTER SYSTEM SET LOCAL_LISTENER='(ADDRESS=(PROTOCOL=TCP)(HOST=lnx107-vip.home.aarisha.com)(PORT=1521))' SCOPE=BOTH; | oracle   | lnx107   |
| Register with listener      | ALTER SYSTEM REGISTER;                                                                                              | oracle   | lnx107   |

## A.2 Data Guard - Standby Database Commands

| **Task**                     | **Command**                                                                                        | **User** | **Node** |
| ---------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | -------- |
| Start MRP real-time apply    | ALTER DATABASE RECOVER MANAGED STANDBY DATABASE USING CURRENT LOGFILE DISCONNECT FROM SESSION;     | oracle   | lnx113   |
| Cancel MRP                   | ALTER DATABASE RECOVER MANAGED STANDBY DATABASE CANCEL;                                            | oracle   | lnx113   |
| Finish apply (pre-failover)  | ALTER DATABASE RECOVER MANAGED STANDBY DATABASE FINISH FORCE;                                      | oracle   | lnx113   |
| Open standby READ ONLY (ADG) | ALTER DATABASE OPEN READ ONLY;                                                                     | oracle   | lnx113   |
| Open PDBs READ ONLY          | ALTER PLUGGABLE DATABASE ALL OPEN READ ONLY;                                                       | oracle   | lnx113   |
| Check MRP status             | SELECT PROCESS, STATUS, THREAD#, SEQUENCE#, BLOCK# FROM V\$MANAGED_STANDBY ORDER BY PROCESS;       | oracle   | lnx113   |
| Check apply/transport lag    | SELECT NAME, VALUE, UNIT FROM V\$DATAGUARD_STATS WHERE NAME IN ('transport lag','apply lag');      | oracle   | lnx113   |
| Check archive gap            | SELECT \* FROM V\$ARCHIVE_GAP;                                                                     | oracle   | lnx113   |
| Check last applied sequence  | SELECT MAX(SEQUENCE#), APPLIED FROM V\$ARCHIVED_LOG WHERE DEST_ID=1 GROUP BY APPLIED;              | oracle   | lnx113   |
| Manual switchover step 2     | ALTER DATABASE COMMIT TO SWITCHOVER TO PRIMARY WITH SESSION SHUTDOWN;                              | oracle   | lnx113   |
| Activate standby (failover)  | ALTER DATABASE ACTIVATE PHYSICAL STANDBY DATABASE;                                                 | oracle   | lnx113   |
| Flashback to SCN             | FLASHBACK DATABASE TO SCN &lt;scn_value&gt;;                                                       | oracle   | lnx113   |
| Convert to physical standby  | ALTER DATABASE CONVERT TO PHYSICAL STANDBY;                                                        | oracle   | lnx113   |
| Get failover SCN             | SELECT TO_CHAR(STANDBY_BECAME_PRIMARY_SCN) AS FAILOVER_SCN FROM V\$DATABASE;                       | oracle   | lnx113   |
| Check incarnations           | SELECT INCARNATION#, RESETLOGS_CHANGE#, STATUS FROM V\$DATABASE_INCARNATION ORDER BY INCARNATION#; | oracle   | lnx113   |

# Appendix B - Troubleshooting Guide

All issues documented here were encountered and resolved during the actual lnx107/lnx113 lab build. Each entry includes the exact symptom, root cause, and verified fix.

## B.1 Log File Locations

| **Component**               | **Log File Path**                                                                    |
| --------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Primary alert log           | /u01/app/oracle/diag/rdbms/cdbprim/CDBPRIM/trace/alert_CDBPRIM.log                   |
| Standby alert log           | /u01/app/oracle/diag/rdbms/cdbstby/CDBSTBY/trace/alert_CDBSTBY.log                   |
| Data Guard Broker (primary) | /u01/app/oracle/diag/rdbms/cdbprim/CDBPRIM/trace/drcCDBPRIM.log                      |
| Data Guard Broker (standby) | /u01/app/oracle/diag/rdbms/cdbstby/CDBSTBY/trace/drcCDBSTBY.log                      |
| FSFO Observer log           | /u01/app/oracle/observer.log                                                         |
| FSFO Observer data file     | /u01/app/oracle/fsfo_observer.dat                                                    |
| Grid Infrastructure CRS log | /u01/app/grid/diag/crs/lnx107/crs/trace/alert.log                                    |
| Grid root.sh log            | /u01/app/grid/crsdata/lnx107/crsconfig/rootcrs_lnx107_&lt;timestamp&gt;.log          |
| gipcd trace                 | /u01/app/grid/diag/crs/lnx107/crs/trace/gipcd.trc                                    |
| GPNPD trace                 | /u01/app/grid/diag/crs/lnx107/crs/trace/gpnpd.trc                                    |
| ASM alert log               | /u01/app/grid/diag/asm/+asm/+ASM1/trace/alert_+ASM1.log                              |
| Grid install log            | /u01/app/oraInventory/logs/GridSetupActions&lt;ts&gt;/gridSetupActions&lt;ts&gt;.log |
| DB install log              | /u01/app/oraInventory/logs/InstallActions&lt;ts&gt;/installActions&lt;ts&gt;.log     |
| DBCA log                    | /u01/app/oracle/cfgtoollogs/dbca/CDBPRIM/CDBPRIM.log                                 |
| RMAN log (session)          | /u01/app/oracle/product/19.0.0/dbhome_1/rdbms/log/                                   |
| Grid TFA certificate log    | /u01/app/grid/crsdata/lnx107/security/crskeytoolctl.log                              |

## B.2 Grid Infrastructure Installation Issues

### B.2.1 ora.gipcd Failed - gipcd TLS Certificate Error

| **Field**                       | **Detail**                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| ------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Symptom                         | root.sh fails at step 16 InitConfig: CRS-2674: Start of ora.gipcd on lnx107 failed                                                                                                                  |
| Error in gipcd.trc              | gipcmodTlsGetWalletObjFromCred: invalid certificate count\[! = 1\] in credSet:0, ret gipcretBadArg (37)                                                                                             |
| Root Cause                      | Oracle bug in base 19.3 crsinstall.pm: store_rootcert_ocr() is called at step 12 (ConfigOHASD) but store_rootcert_olr() is NOT called - OLR credential store has 0 certificates but gipcd expects 1 |
| Diagnosis                       | Check crskeytoolctl.log: if showing 2x "Cluster root certificate generated successfully" entries - the second generation overwrites without updating OLR                                            |
| Fix 1 - Environment             | Disable libvirtd + virbr0, set SELinux=disabled, disable firewalld, shorten cluster name to ≤15 chars, remove virbr0 from networkInterfaceList - forces different code path                         |
| Fix 2 - Apply RU before root.sh | gridSetup.sh -applyRU /u01/shared/software/patches/39062956/39036936 - patches crsinstall.pm with correct certificate handling                                                                      |
| Verified Fix for lnx107         | Remove virbr0 from networkInterfaceList + SELinux=disabled + libvirtd disabled + cluster name lnx107cluster (13 chars)                                                                              |

### B.2.2 CLSRSC-214 Failed to Start ohasd

| **Field**    | **Detail**                                                                                   |
| ------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Symptom      | root.sh fails at step 12 ConfigOHASD: CLSRSC-214: Failed to start the resource ohasd         |
| Root Cause 1 | SELinux in ENFORCING mode blocks OHASD socket operations on OL8                              |
| Root Cause 2 | firewalld blocking multicast packets - CVU multicast check fails                             |
| Fix          | setenforce 0 + sed -i s/enforcing/disabled/ /etc/selinux/config AND systemctl stop firewalld |

### B.2.3 INS-41101 Interface Information Incorrect

| **Field**  | **Detail**                                                                                |
| ---------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Symptom    | gridSetup.sh fails: \[FATAL\] INS-41101: The specified interface information is incorrect |
| Root Cause | virbr0 listed in networkInterfaceList but interface is DOWN after disabling libvirtd      |
| Fix        | Remove virbr0 from networkInterfaceList entirely: ens18:192.168.1.0:1,ens19:10.10.10.0:5  |

### B.2.4 PRVG-11138 Multicast Check FAILED in CVU

| **Field**    | **Detail**                                                                                                           |
| ------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Symptom      | CVU fails: PRVG-11138: Interface ens18 not able to communicate over multicast group 224.0.0.251                      |
| Root Cause 1 | libvirtd running - dnsmasq intercepts multicast packets                                                              |
| Root Cause 2 | firewalld blocking multicast UDP                                                                                     |
| Root Cause 3 | Multicast route 224.0.0.0/4 not present                                                                              |
| Fix          | systemctl stop firewalld + systemctl disable libvirtd + ip link set virbr0 down + ip route add 224.0.0.0/4 dev ens19 |
| Note         | PRVG-11138 can be a false positive on KVM/Proxmox VMs - use -ignorePrereqFailure if all other checks pass            |

## B.3 Data Guard Transport Issues

### B.3.1 DEST_2 STATUS=ERROR - ORA-12514 or ORA-12541

| **Field**    | **Detail**                                                                                                                                                                               |
| ------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Symptom      | V\$ARCHIVE_DEST DEST_ID=2 shows ERROR: ORA-12514 TNS:listener does not currently know of service                                                                                         |
| Root Cause 1 | LOG_ARCHIVE_DEST_2 uses SERVICE=CDBSTBY pointing to SCAN alias - SCAN listener does not have CDBSTBY registered (standby in MOUNTED state does not register with SCAN)                   |
| Root Cause 2 | Standby listener.ora does not have static SID_LIST_LISTENER entries for CDBSTBY                                                                                                          |
| Fix          | Change SERVICE= to use DIRECT alias: ALTER SYSTEM SET LOG_ARCHIVE_DEST_2='SERVICE=CDBSTBY_DIRECT ASYNC/SYNC VALID_FOR=(ONLINE_LOGFILES,PRIMARY_ROLE) DB_UNIQUE_NAME=CDBSTBY' SCOPE=BOTH; |
| Verify       | SELECT DEST_ID, STATUS, ERROR FROM V\$ARCHIVE_DEST WHERE DEST_ID=2; - Expected: VALID                                                                                                    |

### B.3.2 MRP Not Starting - ORA-01153

| **Field**  | **Detail**                                                                                                                          |
| ---------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Symptom    | ALTER DATABASE RECOVER MANAGED STANDBY DATABASE returns ORA-01153: an incompatible media recovery is active                         |
| Root Cause | MRP is already running - CRS auto-started it because startoption=READ ONLY opened the database with Apply                           |
| Fix        | Not an error - verify: SELECT PROCESS, STATUS FROM V\$MANAGED_STANDBY WHERE PROCESS='MRP0'; If APPLYING_LOG - MRP is already active |

### B.3.3 ORA-19906 - Recovery Target Incarnation Changed

| **Field**  | **Detail**                                                                                                                                  |
| ---------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Symptom    | Alert log shows ORA-19906: recovery target incarnation changed during recovery - MRP stops                                                  |
| Root Cause | Manual ACTIVATE PHYSICAL STANDBY DATABASE created a new database incarnation. The other standby cannot apply redo from the new incarnation. |
| Fix        | Rebuild the failed node via RMAN DUPLICATE FROM ACTIVE DATABASE. Flashback cannot bridge an incarnation change from manual activation.      |
| Prevention | Always use FAILOVER TO in dgmgrl instead of manual SQL activation when Broker is configured                                                 |

## B.4 Data Guard Broker Issues

### B.4.1 ORA-16698 - ADD DATABASE Fails

| **Field**  | **Detail**                                                                                                                                    |
| ---------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Symptom    | ADD DATABASE 'CDBSTBY' fails: ORA-16698: member has a LOG_ARCHIVE_DEST_n parameter with SERVICE attribute set                                 |
| Root Cause | LOG_ARCHIVE_DEST_2 has SERVICE= set on one of the members - Broker manages redo transport itself and conflicts with manual SERVICE parameters |
| Fix        | On BOTH nodes: ALTER SYSTEM SET LOG_ARCHIVE_DEST_2='' SCOPE=BOTH; - then retry ADD DATABASE                                                   |

### B.4.2 ORA-16713 - REINSTATE Timeout

| **Field**  | **Detail**                                                                                                                                                     |
| ---------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Symptom    | REINSTATE DATABASE 'CDBPRIM' returns: Warning: ORA-16713: The Oracle Data Guard broker command timed out                                                       |
| Root Cause | Reinstatement takes longer than Broker timeout threshold (default varies). Database may actually be reinstating successfully.                                  |
| Diagnosis  | Check lnx107: SELECT DB_UNIQUE_NAME, DATABASE_ROLE, OPEN_MODE FROM V\$DATABASE; - if showing PHYSICAL STANDBY, reinstatement succeeded despite timeout message |
| Fix        | Run REINSTATE DATABASE again - if database is already a standby, second attempt completes instantly                                                            |

### B.4.3 ORA-16661 - Standby Needs Reinstatement

| **Field**  | **Detail**                                                                                                                      |
| ---------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Symptom    | SHOW CONFIGURATION shows: CDBPRIM - Physical standby database (disabled) ORA-16661: the standby database needs to be reinstated |
| Root Cause | After failover, old primary is disabled in Broker - must be reinstated                                                          |
| Fix        | Start old primary to MOUNT state, then: REINSTATE DATABASE 'CDBPRIM'; in dgmgrl on new primary                                  |
| Prevention | Enable Flashback on BOTH nodes before configuring Broker. Without Flashback ON on the new primary, reinstatement fails.         |

### B.4.4 FSFO Not Triggering

| **Field**    | **Detail**                                                                                               |
| ------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Symptom      | Primary crashes but FSFO does not trigger - no failover after threshold                                  |
| Root Cause 1 | Observer not running - STOP OBSERVER was called or process died                                          |
| Root Cause 2 | FSFO disabled - DISABLE FAST_START FAILOVER was called                                                   |
| Root Cause 3 | Standby apply lag exceeds FastStartFailoverLagLimit - FSFO will not trigger if standby is too far behind |
| Root Cause 4 | Observer cannot reach standby independently - split-brain protection prevents failover                   |
| Diagnosis    | tail -f /u01/app/oracle/observer.log; SHOW FAST_START FAILOVER; SHOW OBSERVER;                           |
| Fix          | Restart Observer; verify FSFO is enabled; check network connectivity from Observer to both nodes         |

## B.5 RMAN DUPLICATE Issues

### B.5.1 ORA-01103 - Database Name Mismatch

| **Field**  | **Detail**                                                                                                                                    |
| ---------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Symptom    | RMAN DUPLICATE fails: ORA-01103: database name 'CDBPRIM' in control file is not 'CDBSTBY'                                                     |
| Root Cause | PARAMETER_VALUE_CONVERT 'CDBPRIM','CDBSTBY' converts db_name from CDBPRIM to CDBSTBY - but physical standby MUST have same db_name as primary |
| Fix        | Add SET DB_NAME='CDBPRIM' to SPFILE clause in RMAN DUPLICATE command to override the conversion                                               |

### B.5.2 ORA-09925 - Audit Directory Missing

| **Field**  | **Detail**                                                                                                                                                |
| ---------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Symptom    | RMAN DUPLICATE fails: ORA-09925: Unable to create audit trail file - No such file or directory                                                            |
| Root Cause | audit_file_dest set to /u01/app/oracle/admin/CDBSTBY/adump but directory does not exist on standby                                                        |
| Fix        | mkdir -p /u01/app/oracle/admin/CDBSTBY/adump && chown oracle:oinstall /u01/app/oracle/admin/CDBSTBY - then restart standby in NOMOUNT and rerun DUPLICATE |

### B.5.3 RMAN-05529 - DB_FILE_NAME_CONVERT Invalid ASM Names

| **Field**  | **Detail**                                                                                                |
| ---------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Symptom    | RMAN-05529: warning: DB_FILE_NAME_CONVERT resulted in invalid ASM names; names changed to disk group only |
| Root Cause | ASM OMF file names cannot be directly converted - RMAN falls back to disk group only (+DATA)              |
| Impact     | None - this is harmless. RMAN correctly places files under +DATA/CDBSTBY/ using OMF naming                |

## B.6 Role-Based Services Issues

### B.6.1 ORA-44786 - Service Operation Cannot Be Completed

| **Field**  | **Detail**                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| ---------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Symptom    | srvctl start service -d CDBSTBY -s REPORT fails: ORA-44786: Service operation cannot be completed                                                                                                                            |
| Root Cause | Service not defined in the standby data dictionary - only registered in OCR via srvctl                                                                                                                                       |
| Fix        | On primary: connect to PDB1 and run DBMS_SERVICE.CREATE_SERVICE(service_name=>'REPORT', network_name=>'REPORT'); then ALTER SYSTEM SWITCH LOGFILE; - wait for redo to replicate to standby - then retry srvctl start service |

### B.6.2 ORA-44317 - Database Open Read-Only

| **Field**  | **Detail**                                                                                                                                               |
| ---------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Symptom    | DBMS_SERVICE.CREATE_SERVICE on standby fails: ORA-44317: database open read-only                                                                         |
| Root Cause | Physical standby in READ ONLY WITH APPLY mode - data dictionary is read-only, DBMS_SERVICE cannot write to it                                            |
| Fix        | Create the service on the PRIMARY using DBMS_SERVICE - it replicates to standby via redo. Then use srvctl add service on the standby to register in OCR. |

### B.6.3 PRCD-1120 - Database Resource Not Found

| **Field**  | **Detail**                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| ---------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Symptom    | srvctl add service -d CDBSTBY fails: PRCD-1120: Resource ora.cdbstby.db does not exist                                                                                                                              |
| Root Cause | RMAN DUPLICATE does not register the standby database with CRS - must be done manually                                                                                                                              |
| Fix        | srvctl add database -d CDBSTBY -oraclehome /u01/app/oracle/product/19.0.0/dbhome_1 -dbtype SINGLE -dbname CDBPRIM -spfile &lt;path&gt; -role PHYSICAL_STANDBY -startoption MOUNT -node lnx113 -diskgroup "DATA,FRA" |

## B.7 Lessons Learned - Key Principles

| **#** | **Lesson**                                                                                                                                                                | **Applies To** |
| ----- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------- |
| 1     | Always enable Flashback Database on BOTH primary and standby BEFORE configuring Broker - required for automatic reinstatement after failover                              | Broker + FSFO  |
| 2     | Once Broker is configured, NEVER use manual SQL for role changes - always use SWITCHOVER TO or FAILOVER TO in dgmgrl                                                      | Broker         |
| 3     | Use CDBPRIM_DIRECT and CDBSTBY_DIRECT (direct hostname aliases) not SCAN aliases for Broker connect identifiers - SCAN listener may not have static service registrations | Broker         |
| 4     | Clear LOG_ARCHIVE_DEST_2 on ALL members before running ADD DATABASE in Broker - ORA-16698 if SERVICE= parameter is present                                                | Broker         |
| 5     | SELinux must be DISABLED (not just Permissive) on OL8 for Grid Infrastructure to start reliably - OHASD fails with SELinux Enforcing                                      | Grid Install   |
| 6     | virbr0 MUST be removed from networkInterfaceList when libvirtd is disabled - INS-41101 otherwise                                                                          | Grid Install   |
| 7     | Cluster name must be ≤15 characters - longer names trigger a known Oracle 19c bug in crsinstall.pm                                                                        | Grid Install   |
| 8     | Disable firewalld before Grid CVU checks - firewalld blocks multicast UDP packets causing PRVG-11138                                                                      | Grid Install   |
| 9     | SRL groups must be symmetric on both primary and standby - add groups 4-10 on BOTH nodes so either can act as standby after role change                                   | Data Guard     |
| 10    | When adding SRLs to standby - cancel MRP first (ORA-01156 otherwise), add SRLs, restart MRP                                                                               | Data Guard     |
| 11    | PARAMETER_VALUE_CONVERT in RMAN DUPLICATE converts db_name too - always add SET DB_NAME='CDBPRIM' to override                                                             | RMAN           |
| 12    | After RMAN DUPLICATE - manually create /u01/app/oracle/admin/CDBSTBY/adump and register database with srvctl add database                                                 | RMAN + CRS     |
| 13    | Role-based services: add ALL services (PRIMARY and PHYSICAL_STANDBY roles) on BOTH nodes via srvctl - Grid enforces role-matching on start                                | Services       |
| 14    | DBMS_SERVICE.CREATE_SERVICE must run on PRIMARY in the relevant PDB - it replicates to standby via redo - only then can srvctl start the service on standby               | Services       |
| 15    | Observer for FSFO should ideally run on a 3rd independent host - running on lnx113 (standby) means if lnx113 fails, Observer also fails                                   | FSFO           |

## B.8 Disk Space Assessment

| **Area**             | **Allocated** | **Current Usage**             | **Recommendation**                                                   |
| -------------------- | ------------- | ----------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| /u01 (Grid+DB Homes) | 60 GB (LVM)   | ~21 GB                        | Adequate for lab - Grid home ~8 GB, DB home ~8 GB, admin files ~5 GB |
| +DATA (ASM)          | 80 GB         | ~5 GB (CDB+PDBs)              | Increase to 200 GB for realistic data volumes                        |
| +FRA (ASM)           | 80 GB         | ~2 GB (archivelogs+flashback) | 80 GB adequate for lab - increase if Flashback retention > 24 hrs    |
| SWAP                 | 16 GB         | N/A                           | Meets Grid Infrastructure minimum (= RAM). No change needed.         |
| RAM                  | 16 GB         | ~4 GB SGA                     | Meets minimum. 32 GB recommended for load testing.                   |
| /home                | 10 GB         | ~100 MB                       | No change needed                                                     |
